The triton runs, the HF runs and the profiles ran at 39053b2 (clean); the golden runs ran from `git archive 615ee61` (a clean copy of the commit, so the run's own git lookup found no repository and its commit field was filled in afterwards from the archive; see xrt_reference_golden.json commit_note). Strict code (strict_model, chain_harness, golden_ops, paged_kv, weights, backend, every ops/ and triton/ file) is identical from 39053b2 to the final commit of this row; later commits only add scripts, reports and data.

hf_anchor_attention: chain runs: HF eager attention (as in the original row report); xrt_reference_hf_bf16 and the HF profile: sdpa
profile_views: wall = CUDA-event exclusive time per region (median of 3 prefill / 5 decode repeats, instrumented run; includes CPU launch gaps); gpu = torch.profiler kernel time charged to the innermost region open at launch (kernel_profile = the first of 3 profiler calls; kernel_profile_repeats = all 3); clean_total_ms = CUDA events around the whole call without regions
host_load: the node was shared with other agents during the wave B runs: load average 335 / 404 / 296 (1 / 5 / 15 min, 240 cores) right after the profiles finished. Launch-bound numbers (decode wall times, T=512 wall times) depend on host load (strict decode B=1 clean 149 ms here vs 132 ms in wave A; HF decode B=1 260 ms vs 130 ms); the gpu view (kernel time) does not (repeat spread below 1 % for strict).
decode_setup: strict: 16 sequences of 2048 random tokens prefilled through the paged cache, then batched decode steps (commit=True, context 2048..2060); HF: DynamicCache from one batched prefill of B x 2048 tokens, then decode steps with full-vocab logits + fp32 log_softmax
prefill_setup: prefill_train = training forward over T tokens with the selected-token logp of every position (strict varlen attention; HF forward with use_cache=False, full logits, fp32 log_softmax + gather); prefill_paged (strict only) = one-shot paged prefill of T tokens with logp of every position; its KV cache is allocated per call outside the timed region and only one is alive at a time, so peak_allocated_gib includes exactly one call's cache (prepared_state_gib) on top of the train-forward activations
xrt_decode_timing: xrt_scoring decode checks now time the prompt prefill and every decode step separately (prompt_prefill_seconds, decode_step_seconds, decode_step_context); per-token decode cost = decode_seconds_excl_prefill / decode_steps
batched_decode_gate: tests/models/muse_glimmer/test_full_model_chain.py::test_batched_decode_is_batch_invariant_with_eviction (real weights, triton): 16 sequences with contexts 1..2100 (2100 > W+16 evicts pages), 3 decode steps, batch 1 == 2 == permuted 4 == reversed 16 == committed 16 per sequence (fp32 bit patterns), and two sequences' committed decode logps == the training forward; the profile's decode_batch_invariance is the same property at context 2048 measured once
